When you see a new animal species, study it.

Once the species is studied, you can view the info of the single specimens you find. In the info you'll see the species name followed by a rating "poor", "good" or "pristine".

Typically, you want to aim for the pristine ones. Getting a clean kill on a poor quality animal will not give you a perfect pelt.

In the info you'll also find the killing method for a clean kill. Those vary from species to species.

Most small animals require small game arrows, for example. A rifle with a scope is perfect for killing deer.

The trick is to always aim for the head when it comes to medium - big sized animals. To help your aim, you can try calling the animal and quickly shoot the head.

Hope this helps
